content.en: We've been distributing NEXVAP's APEX series for 8 months and the sell-through rate is outstanding. Customers love the NEXCORE™ chip responsiveness. Zero returns on hardware defects so far.
content.zh: 我们代理 NEXVAP APEX 系列已有 8 个月，销售率非常出色。客户非常喜欢 NEXCORE™ 芯片的响应速度。目前硬件质量零退货记录。

content.en: NEXVAP's TPD compliance documentation is impeccably organized. As an EU distributor, this saves us enormous time during regulatory audits. The VELO line is our #1 seller in disposables.
content.zh: NEXVAP 的 TPD 合规文件整理得非常完善。作为欧盟分销商，这在监管审计时为我们节省了大量时间。VELO 系列是我们一次性设备的第一畅销品。

content.en: The FLUX Open is perfect for our Australian market — enthusiast-grade hardware without the nicotine content regulatory headache. Build quality is noticeably better than competitors at this price point.
content.zh: FLUX Open 非常适合我们的澳大利亚市场——发烧级硬件，无需担心含尼古丁产品的监管问题。在这个价位上，产品做工明显优于同类竞品。

content.en: CORE 100W is our best-selling box mod this year. Customers appreciate the real-world 100W performance and the intuitive UI. Lead times are reliable — 14 days as promised every single time.
content.zh: CORE 100W 是我们今年最畅销的盒子 Mod。客户非常认可真实的 100W 性能表现和直观的操作界面。交货时间非常准时——每次都如期在 14 天内到货。

content.en: The wholesale pricing tiers are very competitive for the quality offered. We order APEX Air pods monthly and the flavor consistency batch-to-batch is exceptional. Our customers keep coming back.
content.zh: 以所提供的品质来看，批发价格梯度极具竞争力。我们每月订购 APEX Air 烟弹，批次间口味一致性出色。我们的客户回购率非常高。

content.en: We switched to NEXVAP from a previous supplier 6 months ago. The onboarding support was excellent and their account team is always responsive. The VELO Boost 1200 is a runaway hit in our stores.
content.zh: 6 个月前我们从原供应商切换至 NEXVAP。入驻支持非常到位，客户经理团队响应及时。VELO Boost 1200 在我们的门店大卖，供不应求。
